request.deadline: 12-month grant period beginning after closure of the existing contract

Maintenance of the protobuf specification including protocol compatibility, versioning, and documentation

request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor TxPipe
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund UTxO RPC by TxPipe for maintaining Cardano's integration standard in Year 2.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve to fund a part-time UTxO RPC maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
The budget summary lists WP1 - UTxO RPC Maintenance and Enhancement at 525,000 ADA and an Intersect Budget Administration fee of 15,750 ADA, totaling 540,750 ADA.
UTxO RPC defines common methods, data structures, and communication patterns using Protocol Buffers and provides SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python.
The proposal states that Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node have adopted UTxO RPC as a query interface, validating it as an ecosystem standard.
The project maintains more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, language-specific SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations, and is open-source under Apache 2.0.
The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
Intersect will use a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract with specified admin, leadership, and external oversight authorization thresholds.
The proposal states that independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

The proposal states that TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, plus prior Intersect maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC that is being delivered on schedule.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month UTxO RPC maintenance effort by TxPipe, routed through Intersect-managed treasury smart contracts, with stated deliverables across specification, SDK, community support, and AI-friendly documentation; it provides a budget table, governance-process references, smart-contract addresses, and oversight descriptions, but several performance, feasibility, risk, alternatives, and detailed milestone elements are not fully developed in the anchor text.
